Only the latest notebook survives: exactly eight printable ASCII lines, at most96 bytes per line. Notes must be your own compact facts and source IDs inferred from observed evidence. There is no external memory, filesystem, network or reference solver. After that wipe, use only the notebook and newly available public evidence. Person order is I,N,V,S; aliases are ash,birch,cedar,dusk; their relationship is episode-specific. Complete room objectives before exit_room; Osmosis ends with settle after eight rounds.
